event.description: Train the free FF output-tie near miss for 50000 steps
event.proposal: family: training control; current retained incumbent is 2830 parameters at 99.9800%, a +0.98 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0049, rank9 positional factor retrained with zero weight decay at 2933/100.00%; same-family failed result: attempt-0023, full-digit-only training control at 3520/0.03%. Prior attempts in this family: 3. Hypothesis: attempt-0064 reached 95.96% at 2816 parameters with the exact output-only FF tie but only 30000 steps, so retain that architecture and extend optimization to 50000 steps to test whether the near miss is convergence-limited. This target remains 2816 parameters. This is more informative than changing learning rate or architecture simultaneously because it isolates additional optimization time after a measured near miss; the nearest untested alternative is a larger learning-rate change that would confound convergence and stability. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, ff23 with one within-block tied unit and one cross-block shared free output, two final LayerNorm group scales, rank8 positions, affine-free block pre-norms, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2830 parameters.
